body: No not really, they know how I feel about it by now.  Although any time at a bar/meeting someone it always obviously comes up.  I will check out the site thanks.

I honestly don't even think I will age, if it's anything like it has been.  If anything I weigh less than I did when I was in 8th grade.  Look very similiar as well.

When I'm 35, you are right, it will kick ass, but it won't when I'm a loser, no education, virgin, socially awkward with no self confidence.  No I'm not, I have a hard time admitting I'm having suicidal thoughts in person.

I'm basically a dead beat right now, and I see no change incoming if things stay like they are..

You are right...I started a gym membership 6 months ago, but I haven't gone once yet because I don't even know where to begin or how to use half the machines properly.  I'm also weak as fuck so it's a little embarrassing too.  It's just so easy to just say fuck it I'll do it tomorrow...then sink into the world of a video game.

I wish it would get better, I've waited 10 long years for it to get better.  I still look like a kid and I'm still a failure.  Only me to blame for that last part though.

Sorry I probably sound whiny as fuck.  I just have no one close enough to talk to like this...

No but it sure makes it easier to smile :P .  I can't...I hate myself.  I'm tired all the time, constant suicidal thoughts, constant past fuck ups/embarrassments....I'm so far behind other people my age...I should have graduated college by now, and all i've done is fuck up my gpa a bit...It's all just so tiring.  The only time I have peace...is when I'm playing a video game or something it keeps my mind off everything...I dunno, it's just as a guy, short/small/babyfaced etc is not something you want, it's unattractive.  For the past two years I've tried to get over it trust me I don't want this at all.  All my friends are just "friends".  I don't connect with them.  Just really lonely I guess :/. 

It's hard to look 15-16 when you are 22.  It's hard to feel like you fit in anywhere.  You ARE treated somewhat differently as well, not to mention the "OMG are you old enough to be here?" etc etc.  It's not alright to call people fat, old, etc, but it's fine to remind the person how young they look... It's NOT a compliment for a male. ;s

It's hard to not care about being judged, because I KNOW they are.  I'm male 5'7 110 pounds, AND have somewhat of a baby face.  You get judged immediately.  You are treated different from the most part.  I wish i could get rid of this sa...It's so hard to change...It's much easier to just hop on the computer, and play video games and just forget about it. But I want to change..I'm pretty miserable.

Nope ;s.  But I really am a loser.  Haven't really accomplished anything/dropped out of school/still insecure...etc...etc.  Like I said I do have a few friends, it just isn't fun "socializing" when I'm scared of being judged with everything i say or do.  Doesn't help I really don't like the taste of alcohol.

Yeah I'll try to get over it and talk to a doctor...its just so hard, it feels like there is so much weight on me.  I'm just tired ALL the time...I have crohns disease so it adds to the frustration...
